scope: Teacher-label feasibility and DEVELOPMENT comparison only; no student training, blind scoring, deployment, upload or commercial rights certification

development.source_roles: Only existing data-lock DEVELOPMENT musdb and instrumental IDs
development.musdb: All 19 reserved songs, native and vocal -12 dB synthetic remix; decoded D+B+O+V, not independently coded AAC mixture
development.instrumental: All 3 reserved synthetic stereo instrumental songs, centered 30-second maximum; true vocal=0
development.aggregation: Song-equal paired metrics separately for native, weak and instrumental; source windows/remixes are not independent songs
development.caveat: Old development may be seen by pretrained teachers or frozen student. No newly sealed Cambridge acceptance candidate is decoded/scored. No blind/generalization claim.

screening_gate.interpretation: Preliminary teacher screening only. Mechanical/DEV pass does not authorize whole-library relabeling until label listening and alignment review; does not promote the student or replace formal protocol gates.

label_recipe: Retain finite aligned unnormalized float32 teacher vocal waveforms; accompaniment = exact decoded input minus teacher vocal; never independently peak-normalize or clip stems
